text_en: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah, King Sennacherib of Assyria came up against all the fortified cities of Judah and captured them.
text_cn: 在希则克雅为王第十四年，亚述王散乃黑黎布上来攻打犹大的一切坚城，而且都占领了。

text_en: The king of Assyria sent the Rabshakeh from Lachish to King Hezekiah at Jerusalem, with a great army. He stood by the conduit of the upper pool on the highway to the Fuller’s Field.
text_cn: 亚述王从拉基市打发一位大将军，带着大军到耶路撒冷去见希则克雅王。当大将军站在上池沟旁，漂布田间的大路上时，

text_en: And there came out to him Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace, and Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph, the recorder.
text_cn: 出来迎接他的，有希耳克雅的儿子厄里雅金家宰、舍布纳书记和阿撒夫的儿子约阿黑史官。

text_en: The Rabshakeh said to them, “Say to Hezekiah: Thus says the great king, the king of Assyria: On what do you base this confidence of yours?
text_cn: 大将军对他们说：“你们去告诉希则克雅说：大王，亚述王这样说：你所依靠的算得什么依靠，

text_en: Do you think that mere words are strategy and power for war? On whom do you now rely, that you have rebelled against me?
text_cn: 你想空口说话就是战略和战斗的力量吗？如今你靠谁来背叛我？

text_en: See, you are relying on Egypt, that broken reed of a staff, which will pierce the hand of anyone who leans on it. Such is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all who rely on him.
text_cn: 看哪！你依靠的埃及是一根破裂的芦杖，谁依靠这杖，它就刺伤谁的手，且把手刺透；埃及王法郎对所有依靠他的人就是这样。

text_en: But if you say to me, ‘We rely on the Lord our God, ’ is it not he whose high places and altars Hezekiah has removed, saying to Judah and to Jerusalem, ‘You shall worship before this altar’?
text_cn: 假使你们对我说：我们依靠雅威，我们的天主；希则克雅岂不是曾推翻他的高丘和祭坛，且对犹大和耶路撒冷说：你们只应在祭坛前朝拜？

text_en: Come now, make a wager with my master the king of Assyria: I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able on your part to set riders on them.
text_cn: 如今你可与我的主上亚述王打赌：我给你两千匹马，你是否能给这些马配上骑兵？

text_en: How then can you repulse a single captain among the least of my master’s servants, when you rely on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
text_cn: 若不能，你怎敢拒绝我主上最小仆人中的一个军长，而去依靠埃及的战车和骑兵？

text_en: Moreover, is it without the Lord that I have come up against this land to destroy it? The Lord said to me, Go up against this land, and destroy it. ”
text_cn: 现在，我上来攻打毁灭这地，难道不是雅威的意思吗？雅威对我说了：上去，攻打那地，加以毁灭！”

text_en: Then Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to the Rabshakeh, “Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, for we understand it; do not speak to us in the language of Judah within the hearing of the people who are on the wall. ”
text_cn: 厄里雅金、舍布纳和约阿黑对大将军说：“请你对你的仆人说阿剌美话，因为我们都懂；你不要对我们讲犹太话，因为城墙上的百姓能听到。”

text_en: But the Rabshakeh said, “Has my master sent me to speak these words to your master and to you, and not to the people sitting on the wall, who are doomed with you to eat their own dung and drink their own urine? ”
text_cn: 大将军回答说：“难道我的主上打发我来只对你的主上和你讲这些话，而不是对那些坐在城墙上，和你们一样吃自己的粪，喝自己的尿的人，讲这些话吗？”

text_en: Then the Rabshakeh stood and called out in a loud voice in the language of Judah, “Hear the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!
text_cn: 大将军于是站起来仍用犹太话大声喊说：“你们听大王，亚述王的话吧！

text_en: Thus says the king: ‘Do not let Hezekiah deceive you, for he will not be able to deliver you.
text_cn: 大王这样说：你们别上希则克雅的当，他决不能拯救你们！

text_en: Do not let Hezekiah make you rely on the Lord by saying, The Lord will surely deliver us; this city will not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria. ’
text_cn: 也不要让希则克雅使你们信赖雅威说：雅威必会拯救我们，这城决不会落在亚述王手中！

text_en: Do not listen to Hezekiah; for thus says the king of Assyria: ‘Make your peace with me and come out to me; then every one of you will eat from your own vine and your own fig tree and drink water from your own cistern,
text_cn: 不要听从希则克雅，因为亚述王曾这样说了：你们要与我和好，出来归顺我，各人就可以吃自己的葡萄和无花果，各人也可以喝自己井里的水；

text_en: until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
text_cn: 直到我来领你们到一个与你们本国一样的地方去，一个有五谷和新酒的地方，一个有食粮和葡萄园的地方。

text_en: Do not let Hezekiah mislead you by saying, The Lord will save us. Has any of the gods of the nations saved their land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
text_cn: 切不要上希则克雅的当，听信他说：雅威必会拯救我们！万国的神中有那一个由亚述王手中拯救了自己的国家？

text_en: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arpad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
text_cn: 哈玛特和阿帕得的神在那里？色法瓦因的神在那里？撒玛黎雅的神在那里？难道他们由我手中拯救了撒玛黎雅？

text_en: Who among all the gods of these countries have saved their countries out of my hand, that the Lord should save Jerusalem out of my hand? ’”
text_cn: 这些地域中的神，有哪一个由我手中拯救了自己的国土？难道雅威就能由我手中拯救耶路撒冷吗？”

text_en: But they were silent and answered him not a word, for the king’s command was, “Do not answer him. ”
text_cn: 他们都不作声，一句话也没有回答，因为君王有命：“不要回答他。”

text_en: Then Eliakim son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace, and Shebna the secretary, and Joah son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothes torn, and told him the words of the Rabshakeh.
text_cn: 希耳克雅的儿子厄里雅金家宰、舍布纳书记和阿撒夫的儿子约阿黑史官撕裂了衣服，来见希则克雅，将大将军的话告诉了他。
